bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; q="SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_posts WHERE announcement_id=4639) THEN 71 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_posts WHERE announcement_id=4639 AND kind='recruitment' AND status='published') THEN 72 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_posts WHERE announcement_id=4639 AND (conditions->>'dmScreenMessageId') ~ '^[0-9]+$') THEN 73 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posting_deliveries WHERE source_type='announcement' AND source_id='4639' AND status='sent' AND telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 74 ELSE 0 END"; code=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tAqc "$q" | tr -d '[:space:]'); case "$code" in 0|71|72|73|74) exit "$code";; *) exit 75;; esac
